R11_material_findings.reproduction: ASP has 03C_external_route_required_for_complete_bounded_target=true and a nonempty 03C scope, but mandatory_external_route_contract_ids_if_authorized is empty.
R11_material_findings.root_cause: R11 inherits route IDs only from the immediate predecessor disposition. A temporary external_required=false state clears the IDs and a later false-to-true transition cannot reconstruct them because the immutable residual route registry is not a bound input.
R11_material_findings.impact: The summary declares five external-required targets while exact contract-ID enumeration can execute only four; the ASP ladder can be silently omitted from the R11 authority bundle.
R11_material_findings.required_fix: Use the immutable residual route program or a constant route registry as source of truth, preserve route identity across inactive states, require external_required implies nonempty resolvable external IDs, compare IDs in author replay, and freeze a true-false-true transition regression.

false_merge_reproductions: Dell quoted support for USD 150 and eBay Systems wugged PowerEdge XE9680 hardware for USD 15.
Dell quoted support for USD 150 and vanadium labs zorps PowerEdge XE9680 hardware for USD 15.
Dell quoted support for USD 150 and rose systems offered PowerEdge XE9680 hardware for USD 15.
R11_material_findings.false_split_reproduction: NVIDIA provides GPUs and in the following quarter ships them to Dell.
R11_material_findings.root_cause: Unknown-owner barriers require title case, predicate-token collision filtering is case-dependent, and fronted adjunct handling is a closed phrase list. Unproved material right clauses can therefore merge into the left actor or valid shared-subject continuations can be split.
R11_material_findings.impact: Third-party price roles can be attributed to Dell while valid supplier delivery relations can be lost; ClauseOwnershipDecision v2 is not an open-vocabulary structural proof.
R11_material_findings.required_fix: Fail closed on any material right surface unless shared-subject ownership is structurally proved, remove capitalization dependence, protect predicate-name collisions case-insensitively, and parse adjunct structure rather than enumerate phrases.

reproductions: Dell quoted a maintenance service for PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
Dell quoted a delivery service for PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
Dell quoted lease financing for PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
Dell quoted support services for PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
Dell quoted contract for PowerEdge XE9680 hardware at USD 15.
R11_material_findings.root_cause: The nearest hardware-to-price connector is selected before competing governing nominal heads in the same argument group are evaluated. Product bridging proves proximity but does not prove hardware is the priced head.
R11_material_findings.impact: Maintenance, delivery, lease, financing, support or contract charges can be promoted as Dell hardware ASP.
R11_material_findings.required_fix: Establish the governing nominal head for the argument group and fail closed when a non-hardware service, financing or contract head governs the product phrase, even if hardware is adjacent to an explicit price connector.

R11_material_findings.root_cause: Transformation mappings retain connector spans and proof digests but acceptance does not compare them; the semantic relation body excludes connector identity and proof provenance.
R11_material_findings.impact: A connector or relation-proof rebind can pass a contract described as proof-aware and lossless. Current complete-family coverage remains 100 percent only for the observed corpus and does not establish general transformation correctness.
R11_material_findings.required_fix: Compare connector lexical class, proof digest and validated span mapping explicitly; a proof rebind or representation mismatch must either be a proved normalization or fail with a typed flag.
